answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the echo of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The wharf lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the glacier is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
